title: When the Interior Breaks
author: Cyrus Oyelaran
blurb: August Ishikawa, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
